entities.summary: Justin Gunnar Holl is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the St. Louis Blues of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was originally drafted in the second round, 54th overall, by the Chicago Blackhawks in the 2010 NHL entry draft.
